common.notificationsText: Tells you what a sync brought.

account.pictureFailed: This picture can’t be used. Try another one.
account.linkedText: Tells the app which publisher you are, for My territories and the do-not-call addresses you add. Other devices see it too.
account.noPublishers: No publishers yet. Add them under Publishers and groups.
account.linkMissing: The linked publisher is no longer in the list. Choose yours again.
account.linkGroup: The linked publisher is now a field service group. Choose yours again.

result.sentOnly: Your changes are on their device now too.
result.nothingNew: Nothing new. You were already up to date.
result.joined: {{names}} joined your devices. You now sync with them too.
result.conflicts_one: 1 detail was changed on both devices. Check it under Sync and pairing.
result.conflicts_other: {{count}} details were changed on both devices. Check them under Sync and pairing.
result.dateIssues_one: Territory {{numbers}} has assignment dates that can’t be right. They’re marked in red.
result.dateIssues_other: Territories {{numbers}} have assignment dates that can’t be right. They’re marked in red.

home.alone: Territories stay on this device. Pair a device to share them.
home.link: Link your profile to see your territories.
home.pairServantText: Their territories then come to this device
home.addTerritoryText: If you look after the territories yourself

territories.title: Territories
territories.notSaved: Your change couldn’t be saved. The app tries again with your next change.

settings.nameMissing: Add your name, so paired devices know it’s you
settings.followSystemText: Follow your device’s system setting when choosing between light and dark mode

nameDialog.description: Other devices see this name. Do-not-call addresses you add are saved with it, or with your linked publisher’s name if you link one.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: Your congregation’s territories, on your device and ready for the ministry.
welcome.promiseSync: Syncs by itself when your devices meet
welcome.promiseDirect: Device to device, never over the internet
welcome.nameText: Paired devices show it, so the others know it’s you.
welcome.accessText: Then your device syncs by itself from now on, also with the app closed.
welcome.cameraText: Scans a pairing QR code, when Bluetooth doesn’t work.
welcome.locationText: Wakes the app when a paired Android device or the Kingdom Hall is near. It stays on this device.
welcome.backgroundText: Lets Android start the sync by itself, also after a restart.
welcome.nfcOn: Pairs two Android devices by holding them together.
welcome.nfcOff: Optional: turn it on to pair by holding two devices together.
welcome.iosHint: Keep $t(common.appName) in the app switcher. If you swipe it away there, iOS stops waking it for a sync until you open it again.

permissions.backgroundText: Lets Android start the sync by itself, without you opening the app.
permissions.locationIos: Wakes the app when a paired Android device is near, also when it was closed.
permissions.locationHall: Notices when you arrive at the Kingdom Hall, with the app closed.
permissions.exactAlarmsText: Allow exact alarms for scheduled sync

sync.heroNone: Pair the other territory servant’s device once. After that, your devices sync by themselves.
sync.syncingText: Keep the devices close for a moment.
sync.pendingText: {{last}}. They go out the next time a paired device is close.
sync.removeTitleUnnamed: Remove this device from the group?
sync.removeText: All devices will stop syncing with it.
sync.removedBanner: This device was removed from the group. Pair with someone again to rejoin.
sync.otherRemoved: The other device was removed from the group.
sync.removedText: {{name}}’s device was removed from the group
sync.removedTextUnnamed: The device was removed from the group
sync.looking: Looking for paired devices nearby until {{time}}
sync.pairedText: Territories only go to these devices: the ones you paired in person, and the ones they paired with. All of them sync with each other.
sync.pairText: Pair once, with the other brother next to you.
sync.nearbyText: Pairs over Bluetooth while the devices are close together. You both check that they show the same 6-digit code.
sync.sendQr: Send changes to {{name}} as QR codes
sync.outdated: Update the app on both devices, then try again.
sync.oneSided: A paired device no longer knows this one. Pair the two devices again.
sync.repairText: {{name}}’s device no longer knows this one, so they can’t sync. Pair them again, with both devices close together.

receive.pairedText: {{name}} is paired. Now let it scan your code too.
receive.nothing: Nothing new. You already had all of it.
receive.unknownText: This code isn’t from the $t(common.appName) app.
receive.cardOutsideText: Open Pair a device › QR code, then scan the other device’s code there.
receive.tooLargeText: Files over 32 MB can’t be opened here.

meet.pairedText: Your devices now sync by themselves whenever they are close. The first sync starts right away.
meet.nameFirst: First, your name. The other device shows it, so the other brother knows it’s you.
meet.tapFailed: The devices moved apart too soon. Hold them together again, a little longer.
meet.failed: Pairing didn’t work. Keep both devices close together and try again.
meet.nfcOff: NFC is off on this device. Turn it on to pair by holding the devices together.
meet.touching: Found it. Keep holding the devices together…
meet.hold: Hold the backs of both devices together until they vibrate. The other brother opens this screen too.
meet.nfcHint: NFC needs no permission. Both devices stay unlocked with this screen open. The NFC spot is usually in the middle of the back, near the camera.
meet.looking: Looking for devices… Ask the other brother to open this screen too.

qr.pairText: Scan each other’s code. Do this only with the brother next to you.
qr.sendText: On {{name}}, open Sync and pairing, tap Scan QR codes and hold the camera here until it’s done.
qr.confirmText: Check that {{name}}’s device shows “Your code: {{fingerprint}}” under its QR code.
qr.removedWarning: {{name}}’s device was removed from the group. Pair it again only if it should sync with your devices again.
qr.clash: This code doesn’t match the device already paired under that name. Nothing was paired.
qr.old: This code is out of date. Scan the one the other device shows now.

history.title: Sync history
history.text: Tap a territory number to open it.

decisions.title: Needs your decision
decisions.text: Your devices synced, but these were changed on two devices before that. The newer change is in place for now.
decisions.name: Name
decisions.twiceText: To {{names}}, probably on two devices at the same time. Who keeps it?
decisions.border: Territory #{{number}}: border changed on two devices
decisions.borderText: Pick the border to keep. The newer one is in place for now.
decisions.borderKeptMine: Territory #{{number}} keeps your border, on every device.
decisions.borderKeptOther: Territory #{{number}} now has {{name}}’s border, on every device.
decisions.borderKeptOtherOne: Territory #{{number}} now has the other device’s border, on every device.
decisions.deleted: {{what}} was deleted and changed at the same time
decisions.deletedHere: You deleted it on this device while it was changed on another. It is back for now.
decisions.deletedThere: It was deleted on {{other}} while it was changed elsewhere. It is back for now.

automatic.alwaysText: Wherever your devices meet: at the Kingdom Hall, in field service or at home. Only a device with news sends a short signal every few minutes, so it hardly uses battery.
automatic.hallText: Your device looks for paired devices only while you are at the Kingdom Hall, every minute or two.
automatic.manual: Only when I tap Sync now
automatic.arriveText: At the Kingdom Hall, when you get there.
automatic.timeOfDayText: A few minutes after each meeting starts.
automatic.nfcText: When you hold the iPhone to a sticker at the Kingdom Hall.
automatic.shortcuts: Sync with other iPhones by itself
automatic.shortcutsText: Two iPhones find each other only while one has $t(common.appName) open. Shortcuts can start the sync for you, with the app closed. Set it up once:
automatic.shortcutsSteps: In Shortcuts, open Automation, tap +, choose a trigger below, then the action “Sync territories”, and choose “Run Immediately”.
automatic.title: How your device syncs
automatic.text: Everything stays between your devices. Nothing goes over the internet.
automatic.atHall: You are at the Kingdom Hall now.
automatic.hallFirst: Choose where the Kingdom Hall is first.
automatic.missing: Your device still has to allow
automatic.missingText: Without these, your device can’t sync by itself.
automatic.notify: Tell me what a sync brought
automatic.notifyText: Which territories changed and with whom. A sync that brings nothing new stays silent.

hall.text: Used when your device syncs only at the Kingdom Hall. The location stays on this device.
hall.mapText: Tap the Kingdom Hall. Arriving inside the circle starts a search for paired devices.

publishers.removeMissingBackup: Remove {{names}} that aren’t in the backup
publishers.removeMissingList: Remove {{names}} that aren’t in the list
publishers.removeMissingText: For example, people who moved away. Their assignment history stays.
publishers.importText: Only names and field service groups are taken. Addresses, phone numbers and reports in the backup stay out of this app.
publishers.fromBackupText: In Organized, open Congregation settings and export a backup. A backup converted from NW Scheduler works too.
publishers.name: Name
publishers.groupText: For a field service group that works a territory together, not a single publisher.
publishers.linkedDevices: Linked on {{devices}}. They’ll need to choose their publisher again.
publishers.duplicate: This name is already in the list.
publishers.noneText: Territories are assigned to these names. Import them from an Organized backup, paste a list, or add them one by one. They are shared with your paired devices only.
publishers.notBackup: This file is not an Organized backup.

about.title: About
about.appText: Your congregation’s territories, synced directly between your devices, without the internet. No account, no server: everything stays on your devices.
about.partOfText: This app is a part of Organized, the free app for congregation meetings, field service and territories.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Saves everything on this device – territories, assignments, do-not-call addresses, names and settings – as a file in a folder you choose. Any device with the app can restore it.
backup.approximate: iPhone and iPad choose the exact moment themselves: the backup runs around this time, or the next time you open the app.
backup.errorFolder: The app can no longer save to this folder. Choose it again.
backup.errorWrite: The last backup couldn’t be saved. Try again.
backup.exportFailed: The backup file couldn’t be created. Try again.
backup.plainText: A backup holds all names and do-not-call addresses, unencrypted. Don’t keep it in shared or cloud folders.
backup.noStatusText: The device didn’t answer. Try again, or restart the app.
backup.savedText: The file is in the folder “{{folder}}”.
backup.failedText: The file couldn’t be saved. Check the folder and try again.
backup.restoreSectionText: Brings back the data from a backup file. Newer changes on this device are kept.
backup.restoreText: What’s in the backup is added to this device. Where this device has newer changes, they stay.
backup.madeUnnamed: Made on an unnamed device on {{date}}.
backup.foreignTitle: Restore a backup from an unknown device?
backup.foreignText: This backup comes from an unknown device: neither this one nor a paired one. Only restore it if it’s from your old device or your congregation. Its territories and names are merged into the ones here, and that can’t be undone.
backup.restoreFailed: This backup couldn’t be restored. The file may be damaged.
backup.restoredNothing: This device already had everything in the backup.
backup.adoptTitle: Take over the old device’s profile?
backup.adoptText: The backup comes from {{name}}. This device can take over its linked publisher and picture.
backup.notBackupText: Choose a .territories backup file made by this app.

organized.tr_themeFollowOSDisableDesc: If you want to switch the theme back to automatic, you can do this in My profile
